name: Bay laurel

schedule.notes: Buy a small plant — seed is glacial. Plant in a 5+ gallon container in zones 7 and below.
Pick mature dark-green leaves; dry briefly for stronger flavor. Plant tolerates light picking from year 1.

harvest.cues: Mature leaves: dark green, leathery, 2 to 4 in. Fresh leaves are stronger than dried.
harvest.storageNotes: Dry briefly (2 to 3 days) on screen — concentrates flavor. Keeps a year in a sealed jar.

varieties.name: Common Bay Laurel
varieties.notes: The true bay leaf of Mediterranean cooking.

notes: Hardy to about 20 F. Below zone 8, grow in a pot and overwinter indoors near a sunny window. Very slow grower; a 4 ft tree takes 5+ years. Worth the patience — one tree feeds a household for decades.
